metadata.description: The method behind landings that don't read as templates: one authored moment that makes the page's promise visible, a craft floor, and a cliche detector.

plugins.name: landing-moment
plugins.description: Design landing pages around one authored moment derived from the copy, echoed across the page so it doesn't die after the hero. Seven mechanism families with three production-tested components, a copy gate, a craft floor, and two zero-dependency tools: a cliche detector and a real-browser auditor.
